description: An unknown external outcome creates a recovery hold instead of an automatic retry.

steps.action: Report failure with outcome_unknown after losing external response
assertions: No automatic additional execution is scheduled.

steps.action: Try Ready or Requeue without resolving the uncertainty
assertions: Hold cannot be bypassed by a new idempotency key.

steps.action: Reconcile the external operation through its durable operation identity
assertions: No hub hold-clear command is implied by this fixture.
Only reviewed replacement work after reconciliation may proceed, with provenance linking the original task.
